description: The power of myth; this lets you add mythical things to your world and the story, they could have been there all along, or only recently arrived. It could be a dragon in a cave, a mysterious lost artifact somewhere in a desert, a lich who lives in a haunted palace near a specific mountain, etc. Myth is a general term which will let you add story elements that are part of the world and interesting for the game or story. These could be plot hooks, quests, or looming dangers in the world.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical myth; even more fantastical mythical elements, etc.
